findings: Teacher classification boundaries fail on fair-value, leverage, warning, and value-trap cases.
Teacher outputs introduce unsupported thresholds and qualitative claims.
Risk coverage is frequently generic or incomplete, and humanReviewRequired is sometimes false in safety-gated cases.
The deterministic validator catches genuine unsupported numeric claims but also produces false positives.
The critic is too permissive on classification and grounding errors; calibration verdicts do not provide a reliable promotion gate.

recommendation.nextStep: Correct teacher prompt and classification rules, reduce validator false positives, tighten critic acceptance, then rerun calibration and human review before bulk.
